description: Look Mum No Engine is the automotive and mechanical spin-off channel from Sam Battle (of Look Mum No Computer), created to separate his car projects from his music content. The videos focus on DIY automotive tinkering and mechanical experiments, often with an emphasis on older, retro vehicles rather than modern computerized cars. It serves as a place for his "car malarky" and mechanical builds that don't fit the main music-focused channel.
